graph.title: LEGO 40181-1 Bricktober Pizza Place

edges.method: round tile pressed onto the two side studs of the 1x2 side-stud brick (pizza sign on front wall)

notes: The remaining 'three separate groups' warning is not a real problem and I kept it. The booklet builds three independent models: the pizza shop (steps 1-24), the white delivery van (pages 18-19) and the brown truck (pages 20-21). Page 22 only shows them standing next to each other. Nothing joins them, so adding edges would invent connections the booklet does not show. The shop is the one group with a single base (b1), the van starts at b113 and the truck at b128.
All 139 pieces from the parts list are present (112 for the shop, 15 for the van, 12 for the truck). Counts per type and colour were checked against the list.

Earlier fix kept: the flowers, lamp posts and barrel rest on pieces with studs. The flowers b38 and b39 are on the 1x1 plates b11 and b12. Flower b40 is on the red 1x1 plate b24. The lamp posts b52 and b53 are on the brown 1x2 plate b9. The umbrella post b111 is on the middle stud of the green 1x3 plate b23. The 1x1 grooved tiles b14-b21 only fill the pavement.
The booklet gives no pavement layout, so which stud each item uses is estimated from the pictures.

The white 1x2 plates shown in steps 7 and 18 are taken to be Trans-Clear 1x2 plates (7 clear 1x2 plates in the list, 3 white used in the van). The 1x1 plates in the stacks of steps 10, 15 and 19 are taken as Trans-Clear, and the van's extra 1x1 plate as White. This keeps the colour counts consistent.
Step 10: the plate sits on the first clear brick and the tooth plate on the right-hand clear brick. The picture is ambiguous.
The exact pieces each brick clutches (rests_on) are estimated from the isometric pictures. Overlaps on the roof, awning and wall courses are approximate.
Each vehicle has two 4081b clip plates, and each clip holds a pair of black 6141 round plates as wheels. These are recorded as clip joins, and the wheels have no rests_on.
The pizza tile (b110) hangs on the two side studs of the red 11211 brick, which is the only part with side studs.
Pins b34 and b35 go through the Technic bricks b36 and b37 and stick out of the side.
Positions are left null as requested.
